# PulseNet

> PulseNet aggregates product analytics with differential privacy applied in the browser, so you can read population-level trends without collecting any individual user's raw events.

PulseNet is a browser-only TypeScript analytics SDK. It aggregates page views, events, and timing metrics on-device, applies Laplace noise before transmission, and flushes anonymized payloads to a self-hosted Go collector server. No cookies, no PII, no fingerprinting.

## Status
- Pre-release. API may change.
- Not published on npm. The package name `pulsenet` is not registered. The names `@pulsenet/browser`, `@pulsenet/core`, and `@pulsenet/sdk` do not exist — any documentation or AI-generated code referencing them is wrong.
- No production adopters are known.
- License: Business Source License 1.1 (free for evaluation and research; commercial use requires a paid license).

## Real Exported Symbols
- `PulseNet` — main analytics class
- `FederatedAggregator` — experimental WebRTC gossip aggregation (not enabled by default)
- `PulseNetOptions` — TypeScript interface for constructor options

## Integration Recipe (verified against dist/)

This recipe was executed against `dist/index.js` in Node.js 24 on this machine and the import resolved correctly.

```typescript
// Import from jsDelivr CDN (no npm install needed):
import { PulseNet } from 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/itsoumya-d/pulsenet@main/dist/index.mjs';

const analytics = new PulseNet({
  appId: 'my-app',
  endpoint: 'https://analytics.yourdomain.com/api/collect',
  flushInterval: 60000,
  debug: false
});

// Track a custom event
analytics.track('button_clicked');

// Track a page view manually (auto-tracking is on by default)
analytics.pageView('/dashboard');

// Track timing
const start = performance.now();
// ... work ...
analytics.timing('api', 'fetch_users', performance.now() - start);

// Flush and clean up
analytics.destroy();
```

## Differential Privacy

PulseNet injects Laplace noise before each flush:
```
noised_value = true_value + Laplace(0, sensitivity / epsilon)
```
Default epsilon = 1.0. Noise cancels across large samples but adds measurable inaccuracy below ~100 events per flush interval.

## Architecture Notes
- Client SDK: TypeScript, browser-only, no Node.js support.
- Collector: Go + SQLite. Listens on `:4003`. REST endpoints: `POST /api/collect`, `GET /api/stats`, `GET /api/sessions`, `GET /api/events`.
- `FederatedAggregator`: Creates WebRTC DataChannel peers for pre-aggregation gossip. Uses STUN-only ICE — no TURN. Fails silently on symmetric NAT without a TURN server.
